children: FibroBiologics entered into a securities purchase agreement with Chief Scientific Officer Hamid Khoja for a private placement of 298,508 shares and accompanying warrants for up to 298,508 additional shares. Units are priced at $1.675, reflecting $1.55 per share plus $0.125 per warrant, for expected gross proceeds of about $0.5 million. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $1.55 per share and expire five years from issuance. Proceeds will support general corporate purposes and working capital.
: Private placement securities purchase agreement for common stock and warrants
: Raise working capital and general corporate purposes
